title: Worklist tile counts: once per tile, no total, filtered
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin (Settings Service), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag). These are numeric/date-accuracy cases (Rule 116): seed the exact inputs, read the produced value back, and compare it to the stated value - never eyeball, never accept "a number".
  2. An asset with one row Overdue and one row Due in 3 months; a service that has missed several cycles; a two-workplace org with assets at each workplace. Compute each expected count by hand first.
custom_steps:
1. Read each tile's count and the table row count, and check whether the tiles sum to the table total.
  2. Confirm the asset with rows in two tiles is counted once in each.
  3. Find the multi-cycle-overdue service and confirm it is one row counted once.
  4. Apply the location filter to one workplace and re-read every tile count.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each tile counts assets; an asset with rows in two tiles counts once in each, so the tile counts do not sum to the table row count.
  • A service appears once however many cycles it missed, and is counted once.
  • With the location filter applied, each tile counts only what that filter shows.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10570 (S13); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S13; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
